overall: The AG did not reach a violation finding. The Board conceded late approval of January–March minutes, but had approved all of them before the complaint, so the AG treated the matter as resolved and ordered no relief.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to approve minutes of January through May meetings in a timely manner under G.L. c. 30A, § 22(c).
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board approved all the meeting minutes at issue before the instant Open Meeting Law complaint was filed.
